task_summary: Normalize the uploaded public-repository metadata TSV into a FASTQ sample-sheet CSV, preserving sample/run identifiers, single/paired layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata, without validating reads because FASTQ files have not been uploaded.

steps.reason: The uploaded TSV contains public-repository sequencing metadata; sample_sheet_prepare normalizes TSV/CSV metadata into the required FASTQ sample-sheet CSV while preserving identifiers, layout, predicted FASTQ paths, and organism metadata.
